name: Pac-Man (with ghosts)
description: Pac-Man with four ghosts, three lives and power pellets: Pacman Canvas, an HTML5 remake by platzh1rsch.
goal: Pac-Man. The arrow keys steer Pac-Man through the maze. Eat the pellets (10 points each) and clear the maze. Four ghosts roam it: touching one costs a life, and there are three lives. After a big power pellet the ghosts turn blue for a while and can be eaten for bonus points. Score as many points as you can without losing your lives.

score.expression: (() => { const c = document.querySelector('#canvas-overlay-container'); const t = document.querySelector('#canvas-overlay-content #title'); const shown = !!c && getComputedStyle(c).display !== 'none'; const over = shown && /game over/i.test((t && t.textContent) || ''); const num = (q) => { const e = document.querySelector(q); return e ? Number(((e.textContent || '').match(/\d+/) || ['0'])[0]) : 0; }; return { over, score: num('.score'), level: num('.level'), waiting: shown && !over }; })()
score.label: points

credits: Pacman Canvas by platzh1rsch (CC0), played where its author hosts it: pacman.platzh1rsch.ch
